| notes         = It is one of the rarest items in the game, with only a few existing across all worlds. 

It can be seen below [[A Sweaty Cyclops]] in [[Ab'Dendriel]] and in [[Treasure Rooms#Morguthis Treasure Room|Morguthis Room]]. If you talk to the sweaty cyclops and say {{KW|warlord sword}}, he will ask for materials to make it. These materials, however, remain unknown.
| history       = * It used to be considered one of the best swords of Tibia, after [[Magic Longsword]].
* It used to have an attack value of 62 and a defense value of 40.
* One of the few known examples of this sword was shown in the famous [[Tibianic Exhibition]] on [[Antica]], hosted by the Alliance of Free Tibians led by Taghor.
